stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Why can my screen not read it?

stations.title: Her screen
stations.text: Holds repairs as const, and calls nothing.

stations.title: The counter
stations.text: Every clock leaves with its own number.

captions: Dorrit's screen holds the mantel clock as a repair it must not change.
Then it can call none of the repair's functions, and the tickets are typed by hand.
You mark the functions that only read, and give the class one shared ticket count.
Now the screen shows the mantel clock, with a number no other clock has.
The class shares what belongs to all of its repairs. Next, it moves into files of its own.
